paragraphs: Your AI coding agent follows these files blindly, before it reads a line of your code.
Agent.md finds the leaked keys, hidden instructions, dead references and toxic skill scripts in them.

Agents are the default way code gets written. Claude Code is used at work by 47% of US developers and is the primary tool for 31%; Codex grew roughly 5× in six months (JetBrains Developer Ecosystem Survey 2026), with 5M+ weekly users (OpenAI). Every one of those sessions starts by reading an instruction file.
features: Neutral across vendors. Every agent vendor's incentive is to make its own context load more easily. A record of what Claude Code, Cursor and Copilot were told — signed with your key — has to come from someone who is…

Deterministic, not model-judged. Checks are regular expressions with a must-catch and a must-not-fire sample each, tested in CI. A gate that cries wolf gets switched off; this one reports zero errors and zero warnings…

Evidence-first content. Pins are measured, not asserted: each one carries a deterministic judge, and the effect (old-API rate with vs. without the pin) is run on more than one model before it is published. No pin is…
It honours the research instead of fighting it. See below.
